name: rn-starter
description: Takes a clean machine to a running React Native app (rn-starter), and turns a screen list, screenshots or a Figma design into themed, navigable screens (rn-ui), and connects those screens from mocks to the real backend from its Swagger/OpenAPI spec (rn-api-connect), and sets up EAS builds and store credentials for TestFlight and Google Play (rn-release-setup).
